notes: Both classes share every exported slot; the fighter class (0x7104f89e88, 392 bytes) overrides only the destructor (slot 0x8) and initialize (slot 0x28, adds 0x180) and adds the 0x100..0x187 fighter status-data region. Base class 0x7104f73da0 is 256 bytes (0x0..0xFF, same layout). The fighter constructor is inlined in the fighter accessor builder f_71006882d0 (allocates 0x188, stores it at boma+0x40, a static dummy object if allocation fails). Exports with a null slot: change_status_request = slot 0x48 (f_71004ddc40), change_status_request_from_script = 0x50 (f_71004ddde0), change_status_force = 0x158 (f_71004de640: same body as request without queuing), set_situation_kind = 0x178 (f_71004de770, notifies listeners when the value changes), set_keep_situation_air = 0x188, init_settings = 0x1C8 (f_71004dea00: set_situation_kind(sit, succeeds&1), slot 0x180(correct, cliff), slot 0x1A0(kinetic), GroundModule slot 0x3A8, JostleModule (boma+0x118) slot 0x48(bool argument), slot 0x1D0(keep kinds), set_succeeds_bit(succeeds)), is_situation_changed = compare of slots 0x168/0x170. The status change core is slot 0x1F0 (f_71004debe0). Request path: when a global int == 2 the request is queued in the 0x10..0x7F ring; else when 0xF0/0xF1 is set it becomes a script request (0xA4); else it drains the queue, asks a global object (vfunc 0x298) whether the kind is allowed, and changes status. Initial values: 0x98..0xA4 = -1, 0xB8 = -1, 0xDC/0xE0 = 5, byte 0xF3 = 1, all else 0. Slot 0x40 is a reset (history emptied, status -1, situation 5, handler 0).
